verdicts.reason: A keeps the reading order (brand, GET A GIFT headline, subcopy, Christmas line) in a pink panel on the left with the photo on the right, but everything is crammed into a narrow column. The brand name, 'Only this Christmas' and the URL are tiny, the stars are oversized next to them, the dashed dividers float out of alignment, and the URL is stranded off to the right. B is broken: 'GET A GIFT' is shrunk to a minor label, and the supporting copy 'with your next cup of coffee' becomes the largest text and sits directly on the busy sweater and mug photo, as do 'Only this Christmas' and the URL. The gift icons are blown up into the dominant element, and stray dashed lines float at the edges.
